# BBC Science Focus Magazine

> > BBC Science Focus Magazine: the UK's leading science and technology publication covering emerging innovations, human biology, physics, cognitive psychology, and answering the world's most curious questions.

BBC Science Focus Magazine provides expert-led articles on cutting-edge technologies (from necrobotics to sand batteries), human health and psychology, scientific history, and Q&As that explain complex phenomena in accessible language. Content spans future innovations, the human body, physics, nature, and technology.

## Key Topics

- Future technology and emerging innovations
- Necrobotics and biotechnology
- Sand batteries and renewable energy
- Artificial intelligence
- E-skin and 3D-printed medical technology
- Cognitive psychology and learning strategies
- Sleep science and human health
- Memory retention and concentration
- Lab-grown food
- Resistive heating technology
- Holograms and display technology
- Scientific history and inventions
- University research (Waterloo, Rice, Preston Innovation Laboratory)

## Future Technology & Innovation

- [Future technology: 22 ideas about to change our world](https://www.sciencefocus.com/future-technology/future-technology-22-ideas-about-to-change-our-world): 22 emerging technologies from necrobotics to sand batteries

## The Human Body & Health

- [Tired all the time? Here's how to kick sleep deprivation for good](https://www.sciencefocus.com/the-human-body/how-to-reclaim-your-sleep?dm_i=6MRE,R5Y2,524DP9,3DSDG,1): Guide to overcoming sleep deprivation and chronic fatigue

## Science Q&A

- [Why do people doodle?](https://www.sciencefocus.com/qanda/why-do-people-doodle): Q&A on doodling's role in concentration and memory retention

## Scientific History & Discovery

- [Who really invented the light bulb?](https://www.sciencefocus.com/science/who-really-invented-the-light-bulb): History of light bulb invention beyond Thomas Edison
